items.title: Iran sends tankers loaded with oil past US military blockade
items.description: Three Iranian tankers loaded with crude oil have passed the US blockade line in the Gulf of Oman, ship-tracking data shows.

items.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
items.description: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

items.title: Search for six-year-old Ebola patient after armed men storm DR Congo hospital
items.description: Health facilities have come under attack during the current outbreak as a result of misinformation and fear.

items.title: Ex-Nigeria oil minister cleared in UK bribery trial
items.description: Diezani Alison-Madueke had been accused of receiving bribes from oil tycoons but was found not guilty by a jury at Southwark Crown Court.

items.title: Serial killer who murdered eight women in Long Island town imprisoned for life
items.description: In fiery exchange, judge sentenced him to three life sentences plus 25 years to life on four other charges, all running consecutively.

items.title: Norway's crown princess undergoes successful lung transplant, palace says
items.description: Crown Princess Mette-Marit, who suffered from pulmonary fibrosis, will now spend several weeks recovering in hospital.

items.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
items.description: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

items.title: Bystanders smash windows of private jet to rescue passengers after crash
items.description: One of the six people on board died in the crash, a local official said. The five survivors were taken to hospital and are in a stable condition.

items.title: AI will create more jobs for humans, not replace them, Amazon founder Bezos says
items.description: The Amazon founder, who now has robotics and space travel companies, thinks AI will create a labour shortage.

items.title: Group planned to attack White House UFC event using snipers and drones, FBI says
items.description: In newly unsealed court filings, the government says the group allegedly expressed grievances about corruption, the Epstein files, and data centres.

items.title: Nigerian man jailed for storing human faeces outside his home
items.description: Neighbours said the stench from the property had become so overwhelming that it was impossible to relax at home.

items.title: Mangione's lawyers plan psychiatric defence in state murder trial
items.description: They will argue he was suffering from "extreme emotional disturbance" at the time UnitedHealth CEO Brian Thompson was killed.
